Draw a validation sample from a pool of events

Source: R/05_validation_sample.R
pam_validation_sample.Rd

Pure function (no file access). Strategies:

  • "stratified": up to n_per_cell events per species x confidence band; restrict to some species with species.

  • "random": n events drawn at random from the whole pool (or from species).

  • "rare": species with at most rare_max_events events in the pool; up to rare_n events of each.

Usage

pam_validation_sample(
  pool,
  strategy = c("stratified", "random", "rare"),
  bands,
  n_per_cell = 25L,
  n = 100L,
  species = NULL,
  rare_max_events = 30L,
  rare_n = 50L,
  seed = 1L,
  exclude_ids = character()
)

Arguments

pool

Events from pam_validation_pool().

strategy

One of "stratified", "random", "rare".

bands

Increasing confidence band edges.

n_per_cell, n, rare_max_events, rare_n

See above.

species

Optional names (scientific, common or "Scientific_Common").

seed

Random seed.

exclude_ids

event_ids already sampled; never drawn again.

Value

A data.table: the sampled rows with band_idx and band.
